reason: The clearing sky makes cleaning the solar array useful for restoring power to essential services.
expectation: Brushing off settled dust should improve the array's output, though I don't know whether that alone restarts the services.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems relevant, but I want power back first.

effect: The array is supplying power again, so I can move the discovery case off backup.
reason: The frozen discovery needs continuous refrigeration, so reconnecting it to the restored supply seems useful.
expectation: The case will run on solar power while remaining cold; I don't know if that completes the services goal.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but the case seems urgent to protect.

effect: The case is back on station power; the remaining essential service appears to be the water line.
reaction: It's reassuring to have the sample on the restored supply.
reason: The drained line needs water again to resume service.
expectation: The water line will be refilled or restarted, perhaps after the thaw checks mentioned earlier.

effect: The line is primed and water reaches the tap, completing the service goal; now I need to return the troughs.
reaction: Pushing air from the line makes the restart feel concrete.
reason: The goal calls for returning both troughs to the window, so I'll move the lettuce first.
expectation: The lettuce trough will be placed on the growing shelf; I may need another action for the potatoes.

alternatives.reason: I could move the potato trough first, but either order seems reasonable.

effect: The lettuce is on the shelf, leaving the potato trough to return.
reaction: The placement is clear but routine.
reason: The goal asks for both troughs at the window.
expectation: The potato trough will also be placed there and the goal may complete.

effect: Both troughs are back at the window and the chapter is complete.
reaction: The return feels like a quiet end to the storm, though the placement itself is routine.

mostWorthwhile.text: Priming the exterior line and hearing that the pump pushed out air made the restoration concrete and taught me what priming did here.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was repetitive: each was a straightforward placement with little additional feedback.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the description of air being pushed out of the water line; it clarified the restart.

arbitrary.text: No action I took felt purposeless; cleaning, restoring power, priming the line and moving the troughs all followed the stated situation and goals.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to learn what happens to the frozen discovery, although this chapter's straightforward restoration was more calming than challenging.
